findings.message: A1 BUNDLE GAP / AUTHORITY. The resolution of run 003's `authority` escalation rests entirely on specs/decisions/log.md (D-2026-0002), and that file is NOT bound by the prepared manifest (grep "specs/decisions" in specs/content/efmp-302/reviews/unit-06/G3-run007/manifest.json returns 0). The skill states that references not in the bundle cannot silently influence an accepted decision. I verified the decision on its merits - it is status `confirmed`, scoped to EFMP-302 Unit 6, its cited locators topic-04.mdx:77-79 and :131-143 are accurate, and content-spec.md "## Unit 6" now matches topic-04.mdx on the one-page design - but I cannot record `authority` as passed on bound evidence alone. REQUEST: re-prepare the bundle binding specs/decisions/log.md, which governs both `authority` (D-2026-0002) and `sources` (D-2026-0001) for this course.

A2 AUTHORITY. The superseded one-activity-per-category design still exists verbatim in the same G1 document, outside D-2026-0002's declared scope. specs/content/efmp-302/content-spec.md "## Course review plan" > "Practicum project ideas" > "*One-term PD plan* - build a personal professional-development plan naming one activity from each 'ways to continue developing' category; bring back the plan for peer review." D-2026-0002 ruled that design "superseded, not merely dropped", and its Limits say "Settles Unit 6 only", so this occurrence is not covered by it. topic-04.mdx:77-79 argues directly against building a plan this way, so the course-level brief now contradicts what the unit teaches. Owner decision needed: extend D-2026-0002 to the practicum brief, or record why the brief legitimately differs.

S1 SOURCES. Seven of the thirteen coverage rows assert a grounding source that the prose never attributes in the named section, and every one of those sources is declared unretrievable. coverage/unit-06.md grounds U6-05 and U6-06 in day1999, but topic-02.mdx cites Day exactly once, at :56, inside "### The preservice stage" (U6-04). It grounds U6-07, U6-08 and U6-10 in villegas2003, but topic-03.mdx's "### Conferences", "### Workshops" and "### Professional learning communities" cite nothing. It grounds U6-12 and U6-13 in guskey2000, but topic-04.mdx contains no body citation at all. sources/unit-06.md acknowledges only the day1999 case, and parks it inside an "## Unverifiable sources" bullet - but unretrievability is not the defect here; the mapping is, and D-2026-0001 does not shelter it.

S2 SOURCES. Two substantive attributions to declared-unretrievable sources carry no uncorroborated disclosure at the point of use, which D-2026-0001's own Limits and g3.md both retain as a failure. (a) topic-01.mdx:61-66 states "Guskey (2000) ... argues that evaluation must reach beyond participants' satisfaction and even beyond what they learned, to whether their practice changed and whether pupils' outcomes changed" - a specific multi-level argument attributed to a text the register says was never obtained, and MCQ 2 keys on it. (b) topic-01.mdx:113-116 attributes convergence on the six principles to "Villegas-Reimers' survey for UNESCO's International Institute for Educational Planning (2003)" - the spine of the unit (U6-03), assessed by MCQ 4, MCQ 7 and RRQ 3 (9 marks). Neither declaration states a level of support. Contrast hennessy2022, which states "Level of support: abstract only" and whose prose is hedged accordingly, and kwakman2003, which discloses in-line - both of which I verified independently and both of which pass.

P1 PEDAGOGY / figure accuracy. fig-U6-5 contradicts itself in adjacent cells, visible to a learner at desktop scale (see specs/content/efmp-302/reviews/unit-06/renders-agent-g3-efmp302-u6-run007/fig-U6-5-rendered-desktop@2x.png). Its caption reads "The highlighted row satisfies five of the six principles by its structure alone; only teacher choice depends on how the school sets it up, and costs the least money." The highlighted row is the professional learning community, whose own Cost cell reads "Low money, high time" - while the Reflective tools row in the same column reads "Almost none". So the caption asserts the PLC costs the least money while the table it captions shows reflective tools costing less. (Either that, or the trailing clause dangles onto "teacher choice", which is incoherent.) Pre-existing, not introduced by the ded73ec reflow: git show ded73ec on this file changes only the <text> line split, not the wording. The five-principle count itself is now consistent across figure, prose and MCQ 7 key, so run 003's N5 is resolved; this is the remaining defect in the same cell block.

P2 ASSESSMENT. Bloom distribution breaches the approved blueprint in content-spec.md "## Unit 6" > **Unit-end assessment blueprint**, which specifies "MCQs (10): Remember to Apply" and "RRQs (10): Understand to Analyze". MCQ 6 (unit-assessment.mdx:89-94) is labelled *(Analyze)*, above the MCQ ceiling - and its actual demand is lower than its label, since option a restates topic-02.mdx and the unit summary almost verbatim, so it is recall dressed as analysis. RRQ 3 (:128), RRQ 4 (:131) and RRQ 9 (:148) are labelled *(Remember)*, below the RRQ floor, and together carry 27 of the 66 RRQ marks. The file's own frontmatter blooms_summary agrees with neither the spec nor its items. Three statements of the blueprint, no two of which match.

A3 PROCESS / repair-cycle limit, carried unresolved from run 003 finding N11. The review skill allows "at most two repair/review cycles per stage per submission" and prohibits unchanged-input retries seeking a pass. This is the fourth G3 report on EFMP-302 Unit 6 (runs 001, 002, 003 have reports; bundles G3-run003b, 004, 005 and 006 were prepared and produced none). Both cycles were consumed at run 003, which already recorded the limit as reached. The inputs HAVE changed since run 003 (unit-06 docs at commit 3e1d141, figures at ded73ec) so this is not an unchanged-input retry, but the stage is past its cycle budget and disposition rests with the owner, not with a further review round.

A4 HANDOFF. The parent supplied a reviewer run identity but no explicit author/translator run identity. The contract requires distinct author_run_id and reviewer_run_id and forbids fabricating identities, so I recorded the verifiable authoring commit for the reviewed bytes, commit:3e1d141 ("content(efmp-302): repair the run-003 findings for Units 5 and 6"), which is the last commit touching docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-06/; the unit's figure assets were last changed by ded73ec. The parent should confirm or supply the real author run identity before this report is relied on.

S3 SOURCES. No source text is bound for ANY of Unit 6's six keys - specs/content/efmp-302/sources/texts/ contains thirteen excerpt files and none of them is guskey2000, day1999, villegas2003, brookfield2017, hennessy2022 or kwakman2003. I obtained hennessy2022's abstract and kwakman2003's (absent) abstract independently and both declarations held, but the four print/report sources could not be read at all, so source SUPPORT for the claims resting on them is unverified rather than verified. Under D-2026-0001 this does not by itself fail, and it equally cannot contribute to a pass.

S4 SOURCES. villegas2003's declaration in sources/unit-06.md calls it a "Print-only book, not retrievable by the reviewing host". It is a 196-page UNESCO IIEP publication offered as a free download: the IIEP catalogue page returns HTTP 200 and carries a "Download the publication" link to unesdoc, which returns HTTP 403 behind a Cloudflare interstitial. Unretrievable by this host is correct; "print-only book" is not, and the same file's own "## Verification method" preamble contradicts it by describing these keys as "print books or a UNESCO report". The description should say what actually blocked retrieval, as the hennessy2022 bullet does.

X1 ACCESSIBILITY, carried unresolved from run 003 finding N8(a) and confirmed by measurement. On unit-assessment at 360x740 the five ERQ rubric tables expose five identical accessible names, "Scrollable table, scroll sideways to see all columns" (scrollWidth 482/483/488/439/524 against clientWidth 328). The same applies to the two figures on each topic page, which share "Scrollable figure, scroll sideways to see the whole diagram". A screen-reader user listing regions cannot tell which rubric or figure is which. The names come from the site components (src/theme/DocItem/Content.tsx and Figure), not from unit content, so this is not repairable by the unit author and is recorded for the platform owner.

X2 ACCESSIBILITY, carried unresolved from run 003 finding N12. In fig-U6-2 four of the six dashed "rules out" boxes are narrower than the text inside them, so the label escapes its own border: "rules out: training away from the pupils you teach", "...generic sessions on teaching in general", "...advice about a lesson nobody watched" and "...the assigned course nobody asked for" all cross the right-hand dashed edge (visible in specs/content/efmp-302/reviews/unit-06/renders-agent-g3-efmp302-u6-run007/fig-U6-2-rendered-desktop@2x.png). No text crosses the viewBox (measured maxX 912.2 against width 924) so nothing is clipped and the instructional meaning is fully recoverable; the pairing of principle to exclusion just looks broken.

X3 ACCESSIBILITY, carried unresolved from run 003 finding N13. The three table-archetype figures are the smallest effective text in the unit on a desktop render: measured at 1280x900, fig-U6-5 renders 640px against a 936-unit viewBox (scale 0.684, about 7.5px effective for 11px body text), fig-U6-1 and fig-U6-4 render 640px against 900 (about 7.8px). The flowchart, timeline and concept-map carriers render 703px and reach 8.6-8.8px. Measurements in specs/content/efmp-302/reviews/unit-06/logs-agent-g3-efmp302-u6-run007/figure-renders.txt.

P3 PEDAGOGY, carried from run 003 finding 11. Of the five entries in content-spec "## Unit 6" > **Common misconceptions**, four are named and repaired in learner-facing prose (topic-01.mdx:67, topic-02.mdx:113, topic-03.mdx:141, topic-04.mdx:119-126). The fifth, "development is what a system provides, so if none is provided none happens", now appears only at unit-teacher-notes.mdx:51, which learners do not read. It is the misconception most directly answered by Topic 6.3's PLC and reflective-tools material and would cost little to name there.

P4 PEDAGOGY, carried unresolved from run 003 finding 14. content-spec "## Course review plan" lists "Teacher identity is developed, not fixed ... (Units 1, 3, 6)" as a course through-line, but the string "identity" occurs zero times anywhere in docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-06/. topic-04.mdx "### Closing: what this course was for" recaps Units 1 to 5 without it. Either the closing recap should carry the identity thread or the through-line should stop claiming Unit 6.

P5 READABILITY, carried unresolved from run 003 finding 12. Two sentences addressed to a reviewer sit inside learner prose: topic-01.mdx:97-99 "Note that this unit cites that work only for the question it asks; its abstract was not available when this unit was written, so no finding from it is claimed here" and topic-03.mdx:90-91 "Note that scope: this is the right literature for this sub-topic, unlike a general claim about online learning." There is a genuine tension here, because these are also the point-of-use disclosures that D-2026-0001 requires; the request is to keep the disclosure and rewrite it in the register a student reads, not to delete it.

P6 ASSESSMENT. specs/content/efmp-302/concepts/unit-06.md maps CON:EFMP-302-6-12 "Reflective practice as method" to RRQ-08, but RRQ 8 assesses the LMIC technology review and two Pakistani constraints on online platforms, which is U6-09/CON-6-10 territory. The consequence is that reflective-practice-as-method - a named misconception and a full sub-topic (U6-11) - has no assessment item, while RRQ 8 is attributed to a concept it does not test.

P7 ASSESSMENT, carried unresolved from run 003 finding 13(a). RRQ 4's mark scheme (unit-assessment.mdx:210-211) awards "(6 marks)" as "Preservice, new teacher, experienced (3); transitions: responsibility transfers; mechanics become automatic and attention is freed (3)". The arithmetic is sound, but three marks are spread across two named transitions with no stated split, so two markers will divide them differently.

RESOLVED - run 003 blocking finding on topic-03.mdx:99-101. The bare assertion that completion rates for self-directed online courses are "notoriously low" is gone. The passage now reads "Completion of self-directed online courses without an external structure is widely reported to be poor; this unit's cited sources do not establish that, so treat it as a working expectation to design against rather than a finding you can quote", and the hennessy2022 register bullet independently records that this statement "is outside even that scope, and the prose now says so at the point of use." Disclosed as uncorroborated at the point of use, which is what D-2026-0001 and g3.md require.

RESOLVED - run 003 blocking finding N10, the declaration that understated what it left unchecked. sources/unit-06.md no longer claims "No no-external-source row was needed for this unit". It now carries an explicit no-external-source table row naming BOTH passages (the Pakistani provision description in topic-01.mdx inside U6-02, and the doctor/teacher supervision comparison in topic-02.mdx inside U6-05), states that both are "passage-level and claims no sub-topic ID", and volunteers that "MCQ 5 keys on the second, so it is load-bearing in the summative bank." That last disclosure is the opposite of understating.

RESOLVED - run 003 blocking finding N5, the three-way disagreement on how many principles a professional learning community satisfies. fig-U6-5's cell now reads "Sustained, embedded, focused, collaborative, feedback" (five) and its caption says "satisfies five of the six principles by its structure alone; only teacher choice depends on how the school sets it up". topic-03.mdx says "That is five of the six; only teacher choice is left to how the school sets it up." The MCQ 7 key at unit-assessment.mdx:193 says "sustained, embedded, focused, collaborative and capable of supplying feedback". All three now agree at five. Verified by reading the committed SVG text runs, not by report.

RESOLVED - run 003 finding topic-01.mdx:101-105 (Pakistan-specific generalisation) and topic-02.mdx:70-72 (cross-professional comparison). Both now disclose at the point of use: "Both are described here from the course guide and from ordinary observation rather than from a study; no verifiable source for the Pakistani picture was located" and "That comparison is offered as a widely observed contrast rather than a sourced finding, and no study is cited for it here." Both additionally carry the no-external-source register row.

RESOLVED - run 003 finding N14, the duplicate hennessy2022 entry. "## Unverifiable sources" now lists exactly six bullets for six keys, and the surviving hennessy2022 bullet is the full and accurate one, carrying the "Level of support: abstract only" statement.

RESOLVED - the fig-U6-5 caption viewBox overflow repaired by commit ded73ec. Verified independently by measurement rather than by report: node scripts/measure-figure-text.mjs over all 16 unit-06 SVGs exits 0, with fig-U6-5 at 936x400 and widest text ending at 924.3. All 16 files pass both the viewBox-edge and wordmark-overprint checks. Note the reflow places caption line 2 at y=396 in a 400-high viewBox and 6px below the wordmark baseline; the measured bounding boxes do not intersect, so it is inside tolerance but with little margin.

INPUT BINDING VERIFIED. The prepared manifest at specs/content/efmp-302/reviews/unit-06/G3-run007/manifest.json was checked with inputManifest() from scripts/lib/review-evidence.mjs rather than by hand: 137 bound paths recomputed at commit 7d5a918, zero path differences and zero digest differences. skillDigest(root,"G3") recomputes to eccc4074a6f753d12663e5010e19d9b3a0f9f5c461ac8c3a22d093503345998b, matching the manifest. git status is clean. A first pass comparing raw SHA-256 appeared to show all seven unit .mdx files mismatching; that was my error, not a bundle defect - inputManifest normalizes the exact frontmatter line "translation_status: draft|reviewed" to "translation_status: lifecycle" before hashing, and all seven reconcile once that is applied.

INDEPENDENCE. This session did not author or translate any reviewed byte; it opened the unit content and question stems, recorded its own answers to all 25 items, and only then read unit-assessment.mdx:180-289 and the run 001-003 reports, in that order.
